name: Kazoku o Shokusu to Iu koto
original_name: 家族ヲ蝕ストイウコト
source:
Yuki lives with his mother, who is very strict to him. One day, Junko, his aunt, and Sayori, her daughter, start living at his house. Days later, Sayori accidentally sees Yuki masturbating. Yuki thinks she will dislike him, but Sayori smiles and says, "You don't need to hide it...."

[From ErogeShop]
